newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury seen opening lower after results.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury seen opening lower after results.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc were indicated lower in pre-market dealings on Wednesday after the UK food manufacturer released its annual results.

The shares were marked down 3-1/2p to 506-1/2 at 0813 GMT. Cadbury said its full year pre-tax profits rose 16 percent to 592 million stg in the year ended December 28, which was at the top end of analysts' forecasts, and set an annual dividend of 17p per share, as expected.
In addition, the company said it is confident of growth in 1997 despite the strength in the pound.
Yet the shares, settling at a three-month high on Tuesday, were vulnerable for profit-taking, dealers said.
Cadbury shares, said one, "have come a long way. The results were fine -- not especially good or bad -- but I think we could see some profit-taking."
From February 4 to March 4, the shares climbed 41-1/2p, or 8.9 percent, outpacing gains in the FTSE 100, which added 2.3 percent during that period. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
